description_en: Invokes the UnassociateGlobalAccelerationInstance operation to disassociate a backend service instance from an Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用UnassociateGlobalAccelerationInstance接口解绑与全球加速实例关联的后端服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun vpc unassociate-global-acceleration-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --global-acceleration-instance-id ga-1sxeedefrr330000 --instance-type RemoteEcsInstance --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnassociateGlobalAccelerationInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. 

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
全球加速实例所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.name: global_acceleration_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the instance to disassociate. Valid values:

- **RemoteEcsInstance**: ECS instance.

- **RemoteSlbInstance**: load balancing instance.

- **RemoteEniInstance**: network interface controller (NIC) instance
parameters.help_zh:
要解绑的实例类型，取值：

- **RemoteEcsInstance**：ECS实例。

- **RemoteSlbInstance**：负载均衡实例。

- **RemoteEniInstance**：弹性网卡实例
